sentences.zh: 我觉得这也是这些派对创意的一部分。

sentences.en: Ted's going to throw these parties, and it's going to lure in Robin.
sentences.zh: 泰德要举办这些派对，然后把罗宾吸引进来。

sentences.en: And that was sort of the literary, the little literary spark.
sentences.zh: 那差不多就是那个文学灵感，那个小小的文学火花。

sentences.en: That's so great.
sentences.zh: 太棒了。

sentences.en: I had no idea.
sentences.zh: 我完全不知道。

sentences.en: I wish I would have known that.
sentences.zh: 我希望我当时能知道。

sentences.en: That would have been something that would really have delighted me.
sentences.zh: 那真是一件会让我非常高兴的事。

sentences.en: Even though, I never read The Great Gatsby when I was supposed to, but about five years ago, I read it for the first time.
sentences.zh: 尽管我该读的时候从没读过《了不起的盖茨比》，但大约五年前，我第一次读了它。

sentences.en: I was like, has anyone heard of this book, The Great Gatsby?
sentences.zh: 我当时想，有人听说过这本书吗，《了不起的盖茨比》？

sentences.en: It's unbelievable.
sentences.zh: 太不可思议了。

sentences.en: I was like, you guys really should read this.
sentences.zh: 我当时就想，你们真的应该读读这个。

sentences.en: I really did think it was an incredible book.
sentences.zh: 我真的觉得这是一本不可思议的书。

sentences.en: But, so I'm curious.
sentences.zh: 不过，我很好奇。

sentences.en: So you and Carter, obviously, you create these characters.
sentences.zh: 所以你和卡特，很显然，你们创造了这些角色。

sentences.en: You have this thing going.
sentences.zh: 你们一直在做这个。

sentences.en: You've been ordered for, you know, 13 more episodes.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，你们已经被续订了另外13集。

sentences.en: Well, you have this task ahead of you.
sentences.zh: 好吧，你们面前有这样一个任务。

sentences.en: What did the writers, like, what did you stumble upon in the room for episode two that felt, like, really useful?
sentences.zh: 编剧们，比如，你们在第二集的编剧室里偶然发现了什么觉得特别有用的东西？

sentences.en: Like, any eureka moments or, like, things that kind of made the story open up for you guys?
sentences.zh: 比如，有什么灵光一现的时刻，或者说让你们的故事豁然开朗的东西？

sentences.en: Yeah, I think the idea, because I think we were something in, we were in the realm of, like, Ted throws a big party and it goes wrong.
sentences.zh: 对，我觉得这个想法，因为我觉得我们当时处于这样一种状态，我们在想泰德办了一个盛大的派对，结果搞砸了。

sentences.en: And it's a big party episode.
sentences.zh: 这是一个大型派对的一集。

sentences.en: And it felt, we were, I remember feeling very afraid of that.
sentences.zh: 而且感觉，我记得当时对此感到非常害怕。

sentences.en: Because party scenes are hard to write.
sentences.zh: 因为派对场景很难写。

sentences.en: They're hard to shoot.
sentences.zh: 它们很难拍摄。

sentences.en: If the whole episode takes place at one big party, there's that kind of, like, loss of energy, right?
sentences.zh: 如果整集都发生在一个大型派对上，就会有一种那种，能量流失的感觉，对吧？

sentences.en: There's this diffused energy, there's all these extras, how do you make it feel like a Himmium episode?
sentences.zh: 这种能量会分散，有那么多的群演，你如何让它感觉像是一集《老爸老妈浪漫史》？

sentences.en: Like, other sitcoms, you do a party episode.
sentences.zh: 就像其他情景喜剧一样，你拍一集派对。

sentences.en: And it's all one big scene, mostly.
sentences.zh: 基本上全都是一个大场景。

sentences.en: And people pop in this room, pop in that room.
sentences.zh: 人们在这个房间进出，在那个房间进出。

sentences.en: I was worried it didn't really feel like our show or our pilot, which was jumping around in time, lots of short scenes, cut, cut, cut.
sentences.zh: 我当时担心这感觉不太像我们的剧，或者我们的试播集，那是时间跳跃、很多短场景、剪辑、剪辑、剪辑。

sentences.en: So I think the spark was, it's three parties.
sentences.zh: 所以我认为火花在于，这是三个派对。

sentences.en: It's three parties that sort of take place over three days.
sentences.zh: 这是三个在三天内发生的派对。

sentences.en: And within that, we'll jump around a lot and we'll find ways to show that we're not just doing, like, it's a sitcom episode with a party and it's mostly set there.
sentences.zh: 在这个基础上，我们会进行很多跳跃，想方设法去证明我们不只是在拍一集带派对的情景喜剧，而且大部分场景都在那儿。

sentences.en: I remember being very afraid of that, afraid we'd, like, lose energy and seem more linear and, you know, like, traditional if we did a party episode in episode two.
sentences.zh: 我记得当时非常害怕这一点，担心我们在第二集拍派对集的话，会失去活力，显得更加线性，你知道的，就显得很传统。

sentences.en: I remember always, even once we got the idea of chopping up into three parties, I remember I never quite shook the fear that, like, ah,
sentences.zh: 我记得一直以来，甚至在我们想到把它切成三个派对的想法后，我还是觉得怎么也挥之不去那种恐惧，就是，啊，

sentences.en: this is just going to be a wacky party episode.
sentences.zh: 这不就只是一集荒诞的派对集吗？

sentences.en: How do we make it different?
sentences.zh: 我们该怎么拍出新意呢？

sentences.en: But right away in act one, there's a bunch of playing with time, right?
sentences.zh: 但第一幕一开始，就有很多关于时间的玩味，对吧？

sentences.en: There's, like, the fantasy of how the party's going to go.
sentences.zh: 比如，对于派对会怎么进行，大家有一种幻想。

sentences.en: And we see Ted's fantasy and it's voiced over and Ted's voice is doing all the voices.
sentences.zh: 我们看到了泰德的幻想，而且有画外音，泰德的声音模仿了所有人。

sentences.en: It's great.
sentences.zh: 太棒了。

sentences.en: Into Robin's voice and, you know, et cetera.
sentences.zh: 然后过渡到罗宾的声音，等等。

sentences.en: Robin says, et cetera, et cetera, et cetera, as Ted's voiceover says that.
sentences.zh: 在泰德的画外音说出这些时，罗宾说，等等，等等，等等。

sentences.en: And then Barney interrupts and hijacks and it becomes Barney's fantasy and Ted turns to camera, breaks the fourth wall and says, Barney, let's, like,
sentences.zh: 接着巴尼打断并强行接管，变成了巴尼的幻想，泰德转向镜头，打破第四面墙说，巴尼，咱们，就，

sentences.en: that was the moment in act one of that episode that I, and re-watching it, I really enjoyed that because I was like, that's the moment where it became a hymnium episode.
sentences.zh: 那是那一集第一幕里的高光时刻，我重看的时候，真的很享受，因为我想，这就是它变成一部典型“老爸老妈浪漫史”剧集的那一刻。

sentences.en: And I wrote you this little ditty to sing to you in New York City.
sentences.zh: 我为你写了这首小曲，要在纽约市唱给你听。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: And now, back to the show.
sentences.zh: 欢迎回到节目。

sentences.en: And that's another interesting thing about the show.
sentences.zh: 这也是这部剧的另一个有趣之处。

sentences.en: While it's a very hard-on-its-sleeved, sincere show, it also had so many meta elements.
sentences.zh: 虽然它是一部赤诚相见、真情流露的剧，但它也有很多元叙事元素。

sentences.en: Like, it was a TV show that was aware it was a TV show and it was always, like, playing with structure and dicing it up and saying,
sentences.zh: 比如，这是一部知道自己是一部电视剧的电视剧，它总是喜欢玩弄结构，把它切得粉碎，然后说，

sentences.en: or it was also aware of its own storytelling more than being a TV show.
sentences.zh: 或者说，比起意识到自己是一部电视剧，它更清楚自己在讲故事。

sentences.en: You know, like, okay, we're going to show you what he's clearly just saying at the bar.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，比如，好吧，我们要展现他显然只是在酒吧里说的话。

sentences.en: But we're going to kind of flip it on its head and someone's going to interrupt someone else's, they're just going to, like, hijack someone's story in the middle of the story.
sentences.zh: 但我们会把它翻转过来，有人会打断别人的话，他们就会在故事讲到一半时，突然强行插话，接管别人的故事。

sentences.en: I don't know.
sentences.zh: 我不知道。

sentences.en: It was quite clever in that way.
sentences.zh: 从这方面来说，它相当聪明。

sentences.en: I loved that moment.
sentences.zh: 我太喜欢那个瞬间了。

sentences.en: I loved it.
sentences.zh: 我太喜欢了。

sentences.en: I forgot about Ted breaking the fourth wall.
sentences.zh: 我都忘了泰德打破第四面墙这事了。

sentences.en: I forgot about, like, you turn the camera and you just start talking to Barney through the TV screen.
sentences.zh: 我忘了，你可以转过镜头，直接透过电视屏幕和巴尼说话。

sentences.en: I forgot about the lip-syncing where Ted is, it's his voice, you know, with all the other characters.
sentences.zh: 我忘了对口型的那段，那是泰德的声音，你知道的，配上了所有其他角色的画面。

sentences.en: I love that so much.
sentences.zh: 我太喜欢了。

sentences.en: Josh, I just want to ask you a question about this show.
sentences.zh: 乔希，我只想问你一个关于这部剧的问题。

sentences.en: So, you get the pilot.
sentences.zh: 所以，你拿到了试播集。

sentences.en: You're on it.
sentences.zh: 你参演了。

sentences.en: You're actually making a pilot.
sentences.zh: 你其实在制作一集试播集。

sentences.en: Then this show gets picked up.
sentences.zh: 然后这部剧被预订了。

sentences.en: Now, your life, you know, you hear stories out here of people who, like, move from across the country to be in this TV show they got,
sentences.zh: 现在，你的生活，你知道的，你在这里听到过这样的故事，有人背井离乡，为了出演他们接到的这部电视剧，

sentences.en: and then it gets canceled a couple of episodes in.
sentences.zh: 结果拍了没几集就被砍了。

sentences.en: Or you give up your waiting, you know, your server job.
sentences.zh: 或者你放弃了端盘子的工作，你知道的，你的服务员工作。

sentences.en: You know, have a show.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，有了一部剧。

sentences.en: Do you take that in?
sentences.zh: 你能接受现实吗？

sentences.en: Can you not think of it in that way?
sentences.zh: 你难道不会往那方面去想吗？

sentences.en: And do you just have to nose to the grindstone, I'm going to do this next episode and we're going to hope for the best?
sentences.zh: 你是不是只能埋头苦干，想着我要拍好下一集，然后祈祷一切顺利？

sentences.en: You're feeling now that maybe your life was changing quite a bit.
sentences.zh: 你现在是不是觉得生活可能发生了挺大的变化？

sentences.en: Well, it's tricky because you don't want to pop the champagne until you can afford the champagne, you know.
sentences.zh: 嗯，这很棘手，因为在买得起香槟之前，你可不想把香槟酒塞给崩了，你知道的。

sentences.en: I do remember I had my first agent, she signed me right out of grad school at NYU.
sentences.zh: 我确实记得我有了第一个经纪人，我刚从纽约大学研究生院毕业，她就签了我。

sentences.en: And I lived in New York for a while, but I was generally living mostly in L.A.
sentences.zh: 我在纽约住了一段时间，但基本上大部分时间都住在洛杉矶。

sentences.en: And then I'd go back to New York in the summer and do a play.
sentences.zh: 然后夏天我会回纽约演话剧。

sentences.en: Like, I was a little bit bi-coast-wise, mostly living in New York.
sentences.zh: 就像我两头跑，但大部分时间住在纽约。

sentences.en: And I had done a bunch of pilots, and she always got me what's called a relocation fee.
sentences.zh: 我拍过很多试播集，她总是帮我争取所谓的搬迁费。

sentences.en: Because she said, no, he lives in New York, you have to pay to relocate him to L.A.
sentences.zh: 因为她说，不，他住在纽约，你们得付钱把他搬到洛杉矶去。

sentences.en: She always built it into my deal.
sentences.zh: 她总是把这个写进我的合同里。

sentences.en: And she told me on How I Met Your Mother, she had negotiated for me with this dealmaker before.
sentences.zh: 她曾在《老爸老妈浪漫史》剧组告诉过我，她以前就这个交易跟这个谈判专家为我交涉过。

sentences.en: And she tried to get the relocation fee, and the dealmaker said,
sentences.zh: 她当时试图争取搬迁补助，然后那个谈判专家说：

sentences.en: Rhonda, we know he lives in L.A., knock it off.
sentences.zh: “朗达，我们知道他住在洛杉矶，别装了。”

sentences.en: You know, like they weren't going to give it to me.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，就像他们根本不打算给我一样。

sentences.en: We've been following him.
sentences.zh: “我们一直盯着他呢。”

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: So I was still in this $750 a month sublet.
sentences.zh: 所以我当时还住在每月750美元的转租房里。

sentences.en: I was subletting for my friend Megan, a college friend of mine.
sentences.zh: 我是从我朋友梅根那里转租的，她是我大学的一个朋友。

sentences.en: I didn't move until second season, I think.
sentences.zh: 我想我直到第二季才搬走。

sentences.en: So I kept things real modeSt.
sentences.zh: 所以我一直把生活过得很低调。

sentences.en: We lived right around, my best friends lived across the street.
sentences.zh: 我们就住在附近，我最好的朋友就住在街对面。

sentences.en: We lived right by the CBS, like, main kind of corporate building where they shoot The Price is Right and all these other, like, Television City.
sentences.zh: 我们住在CBS附近，就是那种主要的总部大楼，他们在那儿拍《价格猜猜猜》和所有这些别的节目，比如电视城。

sentences.en: Is that what it's called on Beverly?
sentences.zh: 那是贝弗利大道上那个叫这个名字吗？

sentences.en: Television City, yeah.
sentences.zh: 电视城，对。

sentences.en: And do you remember this, Craig?
sentences.zh: 克雷格，你还记得这个吗？

sentences.en: They put up a huge How I Met Your Mother.
sentences.zh: 他们立起了一个巨大的《老爸老妈浪漫史》巨幅海报。

sentences.en: It was the lip couch.
sentences.zh: 那是嘴唇沙发。

sentences.en: It was me on the lip couch with the other four behind me.
sentences.zh: 海报上是我坐在嘴唇沙发上，其他四个人在我身后。

sentences.en: And they put it up, and they kept it up the entire season.
sentences.zh: 他们把它挂了上去，而且整个一季都一直挂着。

sentences.en: They didn't take it down.
sentences.zh: 他们没有把它撤下来。

sentences.en: So I was always walking on Beverly Boulevard with my friends, and it was just like this enormous mural of us on the side of this building on Beverly Boulevard.
sentences.zh: 所以我经常和朋友们走在贝弗利大道上，感觉就像这栋位于贝弗利大道上的大楼侧面，有一幅我们巨幅的壁画。

sentences.en: I didn't know you lived right under this, basically.
sentences.zh: 我以前不知道你基本上就住在它正下方。

sentences.en: That's really funny.
sentences.zh: 这真的太搞笑了。

sentences.en: So that was one of the things where life just felt a little, like, there was this, like, tincture of weirdness,
sentences.zh: 所以那是那种让生活感觉有点……怎么说呢，仿佛有一点诡异的成分……

sentences.en: like a solution of weirdness that got dropped into whatever I was living in.
sentences.zh: 就像是一滴诡异的溶液，滴进了我当时生活的任何日常里。

sentences.en: And suddenly it was like, this is a little bit weirder.
sentences.zh: 突然之间，感觉就是：这稍微变得更诡异了一点。

sentences.en: And then my friend Amy was like, oh, I forgot that, like, people are going to watch this show.
sentences.zh: 然后我的朋友埃米说：“哦，我忘了，大家要开始看这部剧了。”

sentences.en: We're going to go out with you, and it's going to add a whole other element to our lives of people coming up and saying things to you or wanting a picture or whatever.
sentences.zh: “我们要跟你一起出门了，这会给我们的人生增添全新的一面，人们会跑过来跟你搭话、想要合影或者别的什么。”

sentences.en: And it wasn't out of control back then.
sentences.zh: 那时候倒还没有彻底失控。

sentences.en: It was still, we were finding our feet.
sentences.zh: 一切还在进行中，我们在摸索适应。

sentences.en: So I definitely had this feeling that there was the potential of my life getting kind of disorienting and strange and fun, you know.
sentences.zh: 所以我确实有一种感觉，觉得我的生活有可能会变得有点让人迷失方向、陌生而又有趣，你懂的。

sentences.en: I remember Julie, who was one of our, the CBS executive, Julie, who is great.
sentences.zh: 我记得朱莉，她是我们的CBS高管之一，朱莉人非常好。

sentences.en: Hello, Julie, if you're listening.
sentences.zh: 朱莉，如果你在听的话，向你问好。

sentences.en: But Julie, I remember the premiere party saying, she said, how are you feeling?
sentences.zh: 但朱莉，我记得在首播派对上她说，她问：“你感觉怎么样？”

sentences.en: And I said, I'm nervous.
sentences.zh: 我说：“我很紧张。”

sentences.en: And she said, why?
sentences.zh: 她说：“为什么？”

sentences.en: And I said, I'm just nervous for people to, like, know who I am.
sentences.zh: 我说：“我只是很紧张，怕大家……你知道的，认出我是谁。”

sentences.en: And she said, I said, what's it going to be like?
sentences.zh: 然后她又说，我问：“那会是什么样子的？”

sentences.en: And she said, people are going to want pictures and you'll get good tables at restaurants.
sentences.zh: 她说：“人们会想要合影，而且你在餐馆里能订到好位子。”

sentences.en: It's not that bad.
sentences.zh: “没那么糟糕。”

sentences.en: You know, she was just like, it's fine.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，她当时就是那种“没事的”态度。

sentences.en: That's really funny.
sentences.zh: 这真的太搞笑了。

sentences.en: And, you know.
sentences.zh: 而且，你懂的。

sentences.en: She may have left out some stuff there.
sentences.zh: 她当时可能漏掉了一些事情没说。

sentences.en: Yeah, she did leave out some stuff.
sentences.zh: 对，她确实漏掉了一些事情。

sentences.en: But I definitely had the sense, like, like I said, I got fired from my first pilot.
sentences.zh: 但我确实有这种感觉，就像我说的，我第一部试播集就被炒了。

sentences.en: The second one got canceled very quickly after a couple episodes.
sentences.zh: 第二部在播了几集之后很快就被砍了。

sentences.en: The third one didn't get picked up by NBC.
sentences.zh: 第三部没有被NBC看中买下。

sentences.en: Like, I'd had everything happen to me but a hit show.
sentences.zh: 你看，除了大热剧之外，什么倒霉事我都经历过了。

sentences.en: So I kind of felt like, I don't know why I felt this way.
sentences.zh: 所以我就觉得，我也不知道为什么会有这种感觉。

sentences.en: But I was like, well, the odds are such.
sentences.zh: 但我想，嗯，机率就是这样。

sentences.en: And I had a good feeling about it, like I said, at the end of the pilot.
sentences.zh: 而且我当时感觉很好，就像我说的，在试播集结束时。

sentences.en: So I knew something was good and cool about the show.
sentences.zh: 所以我知道这部剧很棒很有趣。

sentences.en: What was strange was we shot the pilot in March.
sentences.zh: 奇怪的是，我们三月份拍了试播集。

sentences.en: Something like that.
sentences.zh: 差不多吧。

sentences.en: I think we shot the pilot in March.
sentences.zh: 我想我们是三月拍的试播集。

sentences.en: And then you end up shooting this in July, AuguSt.
sentences.zh: 然后你最后在七月、八月拍这个。

sentences.en: August, probably.
sentences.zh: 大概是八月吧。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: But it's really, it's a couple days later.
sentences.zh: 但实际上，这只是几天后的事。

sentences.en: But you've had a couple months in between.
sentences.zh: 但中间隔了几个月。

sentences.en: That's the Emmy-winning combination of our cinematographer, Chris LaFontaine, and our set designer, Steve Olsen.
sentences.zh: 那是我们获得艾美奖的摄影师克里斯·拉方丹和布景师史蒂夫·奥尔森的完美组合。

sentences.en: And also, even little subtle things.
sentences.zh: 还有，甚至是一些细微的小地方。

sentences.en: Like, there were always fans, but kind of from far away.
sentences.zh: 比如，一直都有风扇，但算是从远处吹来的。

sentences.en: So, there'd be, like, the ever-so-slightest breeze moving through.
sentences.zh: 所以，就会有那种极其微弱的微风吹拂而过。

sentences.en: Yeah, as I was watching the credits, I was like, well, a lot of these people just stayed on the show the entire time, which is, I think, pretty incredible.
sentences.zh: 对，我刚才看演职员表的时候就在想，哇，这些人里有很大一部分从头到尾都留在这个节目里，我觉得这真的很不可思议。

sentences.en: Josh was speaking to that earlier and just saying, like, it's all of these people deserve this credit for what the show continues to mean to people, because it's so immersive.
sentences.zh: 乔什刚才也提到了这一点，说这些人配得上这份功劳，因为这部剧对大家来说意义非凡，它是如此身临其境。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: It's an immersive universe, because everyone killed it.
sentences.zh: 这是一个让人身临其境的宇宙，因为每个人都发挥得淋漓尽致。

sentences.en: Everyone had a role.
sentences.zh: 每个人都有自己的角色。

sentences.en: Flannel Pajamras would like us to know that the little boy in the claw machine, if you don't know, played SJ in The Blind Side.
sentences.zh: “法兰绒睡衣”想让我们知道，如果你不知道的话，抓娃娃机里的小男孩在《弱点》里扮演过SJ。

sentences.zh: 后来还演了几部电影。

sentences.en: All right.
sentences.zh: 好吧。

sentences.en: Good job.
sentences.zh: 干得好。

sentences.en: And, oh, I just wanted to say that I also love that, it's funny that you were worried that it would feel like a contained party episode,
sentences.zh: 然后，哦，我只是想说我也很喜欢，很有趣的是你之前担心这会感觉像是一集封闭式的派对剧，

sentences.en: or I felt like what was great is it kind of went farce very quickly.
sentences.zh: 或者我觉得最棒的是它很快就变成了闹剧。

sentences.en: It felt very big to me, actually, that it, a court over set, I mean, you have this feeling of, you know, Ted's, you know, you're wearing these wet socks,

sentences.en: like something is definitely awful happening right here, right now.
sentences.zh: 就像此时此刻绝对有什么糟糕的事情正在发生。

sentences.en: You cannot quite get out of it, but you're stuck in this sort of hell of your own making.
sentences.zh: 你根本无法摆脱，而是陷入了这种自己制造的地狱之中。

sentences.en: It's almost Groundhog Day, right?
sentences.zh: 这简直就像是《土拨鼠之日》，对吧？

sentences.en: It's like the same, really.
sentences.zh: 真的感觉一模一样。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Yeah, yeah.
sentences.zh: 对，对。

sentences.en: And what occurred to me was that you've replaced door slamming with editing, that the timing of this show.
sentences.zh: 而我想到的是，你们用剪辑代替了关门，这部剧的节奏感。

sentences.en: He edits the door slam.
sentences.zh: 他剪辑了关门声。

sentences.en: You have your editor who won several, several Emmys, Sue Fetterman, who won several Emmys over this, but it's also in the writing that that bam, bam, bam, that this happens, bam,
sentences.zh: 你们的剪辑师苏·费特曼因此赢得了好几个艾美奖，但这也是剧本创作的一部分，砰，砰，砰，事情就这样发生了，砰，

sentences.en: exactly at the right timing felt like TV farce, which is so rare and great to have on a, you know.
sentences.zh: 在恰到好处的时机，感觉就像电视闹剧，在这样一个节目里能有这样的效果真是罕见又棒极了，你知道的。

sentences.en: Yeah, I love that observation that the edit is the door slam.
sentences.zh: 对，我好喜欢那个观察，剪辑就是关门声。

sentences.en: That we kind of did, that's what punches the joke a lot of the time.
sentences.zh: 我们算是做到了，很多时候这就是给笑点加码的关键。

sentences.en: And that's, we were really adamant, Carter and I, to make sure episode two still conveyed that.
sentences.zh: 而且这也是卡特和我非常坚持的一点，要确保第二集依然传达出那种感觉。

sentences.en: We're still going to be that show.
sentences.zh: 我们依然会是那样的一部剧。

sentences.en: We are a show that is cinematic and we will edit it and it will be, it will not lag.
sentences.zh: 我们是一部具有电影感的剧，我们会对它进行剪辑，而且它绝不会拖沓。

sentences.en: It will not be a big, long party scene that loses energy.
sentences.zh: 它不会变成那种失去精力的、冗长的大派对场景。

sentences.en: It will be boom, boom, boom still, even though we had to sort of play some big party scenes along the way.
sentences.zh: 它依然会是轰、轰、轰，尽管我们在过程中不得不拍一些大型的派对场景。

sentences.en: But I think that's why it mattered so much to us to do that kind of cinematic montage at the end that equates Ted to the little boy climbing up, trying to grab the prize,
sentences.zh: 但我觉得这就是为什么在最后做一个那样的电影式蒙太奇对我们来说如此重要，它把泰德等同于那个往上爬、试图抓住奖品的小男孩，

sentences.en: trying to beat the system and skip the necessary steps and jump ahead and grab the prize and he ends up getting stuck in there.
sentences.zh: 试图战胜体制、跳过必要的步骤、超前并抓住奖品，结果他最后被卡在了里面。

sentences.en: And there's obviously a very nice metaphor there for what Ted's trying to do and speaking to some of Ted's own flaws of thinking he can plan everything and skip ahead.
sentences.zh: 这里显然有一个非常美妙的隐喻，关乎泰德试图做的事情，也直指泰德自身的一些缺点，比如他认为自己可以计划一切并跳级。

sentences.en: And, you know, the whole, I liked when Ted was, when Ted says this line in the episode of like, I can still win this.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道的，我喜欢泰德在这一集里说的那句台词：我还能赢。

sentences.en: And that metaphor of the game, it's a game I can win.
sentences.zh: 以及那个关于游戏的隐喻，这是一场我能赢的游戏。

sentences.en: It's a, it's a blueprint I can draw.
sentences.zh: 这是一张我能画出的蓝图。

sentences.en: It's a plan I can achieve perfectly.
sentences.zh: 这是一个我能完美实现的计划。

sentences.en: And that is Ted's flaw.
sentences.zh: 这就是泰德的缺点。

sentences.en: He has to let go of some of that.
sentences.zh: 他必须放下一部分这种执念。

sentences.en: In some ways, Ted is like Horatio Alger.
sentences.zh: 从某种意义上说，泰德就像霍雷肖·阿尔杰。

sentences.en: He's like the American dream.
sentences.zh: 他就像美国梦的化身。

sentences.en: He's like, he's really bought into this idea that with effort and with vision, I can do anything, you know?
sentences.zh: 他就像，他真的深信这种想法：只要付出努力和眼光，我什么都能做到，你知道吗？

sentences.en: And I think that that's lovable, but it's also, it's not, at least at the beginning of the series, it's not tempered by realism, by patience,
sentences.zh: 我觉得这很讨人喜欢，但同时，至少在剧集刚开始的时候，它并没有被现实主义和耐心所调和，

sentences.en: by like what the show and what the universe and what these experiences teach him is, you know, you can only plan so much.
sentences.zh: 这部剧、整个宇宙以及这些经历教导他的是，你知道的，计划永远赶不上变化。

sentences.en: Like we, like, like it's a perfect job for him.
sentences.zh: 就好像我们，呃，这对他来说是一份完美的工作。

sentences.en: He's an architect.
sentences.zh: 他是一名建筑师。

sentences.en: He's trying to construct and build this life for himself.
sentences.zh: 他正试图为自己构建和打造这样一种生活。

sentences.en: And the universe keeps like, you know, blowing away the blueprint and putting it in a puddle of water.
sentences.zh: 而宇宙却一直在，你知道的，把蓝图吹飞，然后扔进水坑里。

sentences.en: It's like, he's not going to be able to, he has to, I mean, it's like, I don't know, Star Wars, but like he has to like take off the thing and like guide.
sentences.zh: 这就好像，他没法，他不得不，我是说，这就像是，我不知道，《星球大战》，但他不得不摘下那个东西然后凭感觉指引。

sentences.en: Is that like Star Wars, right?
sentences.zh: 就像《星球大战》里那样，对吧？

sentences.en: Like where he has to take off the vision thing and he has to do it blind and just feel it.
sentences.zh: 就像他必须摘下那个面罩，蒙上双眼，全凭感觉去感知。

sentences.en: I think, I think versions of that happen about eight times since we're going to be a Star Wars movie.
sentences.zh: 我觉得，我觉得自从我们要拍成《星球大战》电影以来，类似的情节大概发生了八次。

sentences.en: No, but isn't that a thing in Star Wars?
sentences.zh: 不，但《星球大战》里不是本来就有这出吗？

sentences.zh: 其实我没那么了解它。

sentences.zh: 我不是那种《星球大战》迷。

sentences.en: That's why I was tentative about that.
sentences.zh: 这就是为什么我刚才说得有点没底气。

sentences.en: I love how you're really trying to pretend you don't watch that movie every day.
sentences.zh: 我太喜欢你极力假装自己没有天天看那部电影的样子了。

sentences.en: It's not working.
sentences.zh: 根本没用。

sentences.en: Well, maybe I should stop citing it.
sentences.zh: 好吧，也许我该停止引用它了。

sentences.en: I know, you're bringing this on yourself.
sentences.zh: 我知道，这是你自找的。

sentences.en: You know, I mean, it is a little bit like Groundhog because Ted is trying to construct fate and destiny here over and over again in this episode.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，我是说，这有点像《土拨鼠之日》，因为在这集里，泰德一次又一次地试图构筑缘分和命运。

sentences.en: He's trying to manufacture things that maybe are supposed to happen more organically.
sentences.zh: 他试图人为制造那些本该更自然发生的事情。

sentences.en: He's running into live shots of the news.
sentences.zh: 他闯入了正在直播的新闻现场。

sentences.en: He's doing not one party, not two parties, but three parties and pretending that was the plan the whole time.
sentences.zh: 他办的不是一个派对，也不是两个，而是三个派对，还假装这一切从头到尾都在计划之中。

sentences.en: He's sort of trying to fake out destiny and cheat destiny, just like that little kid was trying to steal the purple giraffe.
sentences.zh: 他有点像是在糊弄命运、欺骗命运，就像那个小男孩试图偷走紫色长颈鹿一样。

sentences.en: By the way, cameo alert.
sentences.zh: 顺便说一句，彩蛋客串警报。

sentences.en: And I know this is not a visual medium for most people, but purple giraffe.
sentences.zh: 我知道对大多数人来说这不是个视觉媒介，但这就是紫色长颈鹿。

sentences.en: That's the actual PG?
sentences.zh: 这就是真正的PG？

sentences.en: This is the purple giraffe.
sentences.zh: 这就是那只紫色长颈鹿。

sentences.en: Named so, and this item is what it is because my wife's favorite color is purple, and her favorite animal is a giraffe, and the purple giraffe lives in our home to this day.
sentences.zh: 之所以叫这个名字，之所以有这个道具，是因为我太太最喜欢的颜色是紫色，她最喜欢的动物是长颈鹿，而这只紫色长颈鹿直到今天还住在我们家里。

sentences.en: Isn't that amazing that you and Carter could just be like, it'll be a purple giraffe, and then they just present you with a purple giraffe.
sentences.zh: 你不觉得很神奇吗？你和卡特只要说一句“我们要一只紫色长颈鹿”，然后他们就会给你呈上一只紫色长颈鹿。

sentences.en: Like, you just manifest these things out of your imagination, and then they make it real.
sentences.zh: 就像是，你把这些东西从想象中具象化，然后他们就把它变成了现实。

sentences.en: Yeah, and props had to make that, and it was a pain in the ass.
sentences.zh: 对啊，道具组必须把这东西做出来，这可真是个让人头疼的差事。

sentences.en: I remember, like, Dave from props coming around, like, is this okay?
sentences.zh: 我记得，道具组的戴夫跑过来问，这样行吗？

sentences.en: And he was, like, having to cobble it together.
sentences.zh: 他当时不得不东拼西凑地把它搞定。

sentences.en: There wasn't just a purple giraffe to buy.
sentences.zh: 市面上又没有现成的紫色长颈鹿可以买。

sentences.en: He had to, like, make this thing.
sentences.zh: 他必须把这东西亲手做出来。

sentences.en: Right, right.
sentences.zh: 对，对。

sentences.en: I love this idea that Ted is, he's both a believer in destiny, but he also disbelieves it.
sentences.zh: 我特别喜欢这种设定：泰德他既是个宿命论者，但同时他又怀疑命运。

sentences.en: He doesn't believe that it'll just happen.
sentences.zh: 他不相信事情会顺其自然地发生。

sentences.en: Like, he has to engineer it.
sentences.zh: 就像，他必须去人为设计这一切。

sentences.en: He has to get in there and metal.
sentences.zh: 他非得插手并从中干涉。

sentences.en: He has to architect it.
sentences.zh: 他得像个建筑师一样去规划它。

sentences.en: He has to architect it.
sentences.zh: 他得像个建筑师一样去规划它。

sentences.en: Cool architect stuff.
sentences.zh: 酷炫的建筑师作风。

sentences.en: I love when he said that.
sentences.zh: 我太喜欢他当时说的那句话了。

sentences.en: So he, yeah, one of my favorites.
sentences.zh: 所以他，没错，我最喜欢的桥段之一。

sentences.en: But he really wants to be the beneficiary of the blessing of the universe.
sentences.zh: 但他真的很想成为沐浴在宇宙祝福之中的受益者。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: But he refuses to allow the universe to do its job.
sentences.zh: 但他拒绝让宇宙发挥它的作用。

sentences.en: Yeah, that's such a great way to put it.
sentences.zh: 没错，这个比喻真的太妙了。

sentences.en: He wants to climb up into that toy machine and get the toy he wants.
sentences.zh: 他想爬进那个抓娃娃机里，去拿他想要的那件玩具。

sentences.en: That's not how it works.
sentences.zh: 事情根本不是这样的。

sentences.en: And so I think part of why we want to do that big cinematic montage of sort of Ted and the kid
sentences.zh: 所以我觉得，我们之所以想拍那段大型电影质感的蒙太奇，展示泰德和那个孩子

sentences.en: and the attempt, the claw reaching for this thing that it shouldn't, you know, it can't quite grasp.
sentences.zh: 还有那次尝试，机械爪伸向不该去抓的东西，你知道的，它根本抓不稳。

sentences.en: That was us wanting to say, this is not just our party episode.
sentences.zh: 那是我们的意图，想告诉大家，这不仅仅是我们的派对集。

sentences.en: It's a wacky party.
sentences.zh: 这是一场疯狂的派对。

sentences.en: It's like, this episode's about something, too.
sentences.zh: 就像是，这一集也是有深刻内涵的。

sentences.en: And it's about something that, Ted, we will watch this series.
sentences.zh: 而且它的内涵关乎，泰德，我们会看完整部剧集的。

sentences.en: I feel like that episode gave you a whole bunch of threads to track through the rest of the series.
sentences.zh: 我觉得那一集为你提供了大量线索，可以贯穿整部剧集去追踪。

sentences.en: One of them being Ted's tug of war between do you let something just happen or do you architect it into happening?
sentences.zh: 其中之一就是泰德内心的拉锯战：你是顺其自然发生，还是处心积虑让它发生？

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And that is one of the central big debates.
sentences.zh: 而这也是核心的大辩论之一。

sentences.en: And with the second episode, you're still training the audience how to watch the show.
sentences.zh: 到了第二集，你其实仍在训练观众如何观看这部剧。

sentences.en: You're outlining themes.
sentences.zh: 你在勾勒主题。

sentences.en: You're showing, this is what our editing is like.
sentences.zh: 你在展示：这就是我们的剪辑风格。

sentences.en: You're really teaching them the rhythms of how to watch the show.
sentences.zh: 你真的在教导他们如何观看这部剧的节奏。

sentences.en: And I think one of the satisfying things for people about watching the show is once it clicks in their brain, like this is the kind of show I'm watching,
sentences.zh: 而且我觉得，观众看这部剧时感到满足的一点在于，一旦他们的脑海中开窍了——意识到这是一部什么样的剧——

sentences.en: it's so satisfying because it allows you, it makes you do a little bit of work.
sentences.zh: 那种感觉太棒了，因为它允许你、甚至要求你动一点脑筋。

sentences.en: Yeah, definitely.
sentences.zh: 对，绝对是这样。

sentences.en: And we like doing a little bit of work.
sentences.zh: 而且我们也喜欢动点脑筋。

sentences.en: Oh, yeah.
sentences.zh: 哦，是的。
